description: List - an inset grouped list: titled groups of tappable rows on a raised surface.

usage.when: Show groups of records (roles, documents, settings) as rows with a leading tile, a title, one description line, one meta line and one quiet trailing affordance; the whole row opens the record.
usage.whenNot: A rail of sibling pages with one marked current, term and value pairs, or a data grid with columns.

useInstead.reason: a rail of destinations with the open one marked current
term and value pairs about one object
